meta.title: RoamiSIM — Travel eSIMs in Telegram
meta.description: Find a travel eSIM with RoamiSIM: browse destination plans, pay with Telegram Stars, compare estimated USD prices and install with a QR code. Available in English, Russian and Azerbaijani.
hero.title:
New country.
Already connected.
hero.description: Find your travel eSIM in Telegram. Compare plans, pay with Stars and get your installation details right in the bot.
hero.note: No plastic SIM card. All in your Telegram.
visual.caption: Less planning. More exploring.
destinations.title: Where are we going?
destinations.description: Open the catalogue in the bot, choose your destination and find the right amount of data and duration for your trip.
how.title: From travel plans to data in three steps.
how.choose.title: Choose your destination
how.choose.text: Pick the country you are visiting. Compare available plans by data allowance, duration and price.
how.pay.title: Pay in Telegram
how.pay.text: The bot shows the price in Stars and an estimated USD equivalent. Check the plan conditions and confirm your payment.
how.install.title: Install your eSIM
how.install.text: Get a QR code and installation details in the bot. Activation rules depend on the plan you choose.
pricing.title: Clear prices. Familiar payments.
pricing.text: Pay with Telegram Stars. An estimated dollar equivalent appears alongside the price to make comparing plans easier.
pricing.note: The dollar amount is an estimate. The actual cost of buying Stars depends on Telegram, your platform and payment method.
compatibility.title: One thing before you buy
compatibility.text: Make sure your phone supports eSIM and is not locked to a carrier. You will need internet to install it, such as your home Wi-Fi.
faq.title: Good questions before you go
faq.q1: Will an eSIM work on my phone?
faq.a1: Your phone must support eSIM and be unlocked for use with other carriers. Check your device model's specifications before buying.
faq.a2: It depends on the plan: on installation or on first connection to a network. The bot shows activation conditions before payment. Read them before installing.
faq.q3: Where can I find my order and get help?
faq.a3: Your purchases are in the bot's orders section. If you need help, open support in the bot and your message will reach the service administrator.
cta.title: Your next adventure starts here.
cta.text: Open RoamiSIM in Telegram and find data for your next trip.
footer.rights: RoamiSIM. Stay connected as you explore.
